researchNotes: Bounded direct-service search examined local nonprofit programs. Followed City Hope's dedicated receiving-help page and Paz de Cristo's linked Clothe page. Paz direct adult closet remains supported separately from contradictory voucher availability. Other searched leads (Casa de Amor, La Mesa) remain unexpanded notes. No excluded providers investigated. 3 web calls, 1 search query, 3 explicit opens/clicks. Stage elapsed approximately 3 minutes; active estimate 3 minutes includes reading/writing/tool orchestration, waiting 0.02 minutes rounded from web latency. Not exhaustive.

observations.summary: City Hope: Gilbert center offers no-cost clothing. Walk in with driver license or government ID; one visit per center per calendar month; arrive at least 15 minutes before close. Gilbert address 1120 S Gilbert Rd Suite 101, Gilbert AZ 85296; phone 480-900-5422; Mon/Wed/Sat 9–11:30am; distribution can close at 80 guests. Mesa center specifically says food only despite broad homepage clothing statement.
questions: Does the Mesa center currently provide any clothing? The homepage says clothing for all guests, but Centers explicitly says Mesa is food only.

observations.summary: Paz de Cristo Clothing Closet at 424 W Broadway Rd, Mesa AZ 85210 serves adults, not children, Mondays/Fridays 1–2pm. Visit campus; front desk 480-464-2370. Clothing includes casual and interview attire, sizes and seasonal gear depend on donations. Wednesday showers 9am–1pm include clothing/hygiene. Deseret Industries vouchers are described as appointment-only on Clothe and at top of Get Help, but Get Help's service list says temporarily unavailable; preserve direct clothing help without promising vouchers.
questions: Are Deseret Industries clothing vouchers available now? The Get Help service list says temporarily unavailable while Clothe and the overview say appointment only.
What documents, repeat-visit limits and accessibility arrangements apply to the adult Clothing Closet?
